name: Après le considérant 12 – 54
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2018/848 as regards certain production, labelling and certification rules and certain rules on trade with third countries
part_text: (12a) The European Commission should publish an annual report on the impact of imports of organic products from third countries on prices, volumes, market shares, producers’ income and the sustainability of organic farms in the Union.
